Description: Auto-send 3 emails (Day 0, 2, 7) to new users. Welcome → tutorial → social proof.
Implementation: Set up in ConvertKit or Resend. Write 3 emails once. Trigger on Supabase auth webhook.
Anti_Pattern: Sending manual welcome emails to each user

Description: Auto-retry failed payments 3 times over 7 days. Send email after each failure.
Implementation: Enable Stripe Smart Retries. Set up failed payment email. Cancel only after 3 fails + 7 days.
Anti_Pattern: Immediately canceling on first payment failure

Description: Stripe generates invoices automatically on payment. Forward to accounting.
Implementation: Enable Stripe invoicing. Set company info + logo. Invoices auto-sent to customers.
Anti_Pattern: Manually creating invoices for each customer

Description: Auto-alert on errors via Slack/email. Group by frequency. Fix top errors first.
Implementation: Install Sentry SDK. Set up Slack webhook for critical errors. Review weekly error summary.
Anti_Pattern: Discovering errors only when users complain

Description: Batch-create social posts on Sunday. Schedule for the week. Never think about posting again.
Implementation: Write 5-7 posts Sunday. Schedule via Buffer. Engage with replies 10 min/day.
Anti_Pattern: Posting manually in real-time every day

Description: Monitor your site/app/API every 60 seconds. Alert via email+Slack on downtime.
Implementation: Set up UptimeRobot for main URL + API endpoint + Stripe webhook URL.
Anti_Pattern: Not knowing your site is down until a user tweets about it

Description: Automatic daily backups. Test restore quarterly. Sleep well.
Implementation: Enable Supabase PITR on Pro plan. Set up monthly restore test reminder.
Anti_Pattern: No backups until first data loss incident

Description: Auto-track key events: signup activation core-action upgrade churn. Dashboard updates real-time.
Implementation: Install PostHog. Define 5 key events. Build dashboard. Review weekly Monday.
Anti_Pattern: Manual analytics — downloading CSVs and building charts

Description: Auto-send NPS or Sean Ellis survey 30 days after signup. Aggregate monthly.
Implementation: Set up Tally survey. Trigger via email automation at day 30. Review results monthly.
Anti_Pattern: Manually asking users for feedback one by one

Description: Auto-generate changelog from git commits or manual entry. Notify users of updates.
Implementation: Write changelog entry as part of deploy process. Send to email list monthly.
Anti_Pattern: Users discovering new features months later by accident
